snippet.title: ShelfLife: Art School Detective Demo Announcement Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
As part of Fellow Traveller's Story-Rich Showcase, ShelfLife: Art School Detective is releasing an official Steam Demo!
 
This 50 minute demo gives players a glimpse into ShelfLife's 'Mystery Adventure' meets 'Detective Dating Sim' gameplay. There'll be clue-collecting, mixed-media Art Worlds, psychic powers, logic puzzles... PLUS, a cast of charming art school weirdos to Investi-Date!

Wishlist ShelfLife now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537020/ShelfLife_Art_School_Detective/
